{"CultureInvariantString":"Communication with Alpha... lost
Communication with Bravo... lost
Communication with Charlie... lost
Communication with Delta... lost
Communication with Oil Rig #01... lost
Communication with Oil Rig #02... up
Communication with Trident... lost
Communication with Elm Creek City... lost"}
{"CultureInvariantString":"All contact has been lost...\r\nFalling back to Observatory Alpha...\r\n..."}

{"CultureInvariantString":"We came across the crash in the early hours to find 2 casualties.
Both had catastrophic bleeds and had to be sent to the closest hospital for surgery.
They kept on speaking about a virus coming, one we hadn't seen ever before and they said there was one other person with them.
We are still looking for this person, afraid for their injuries or if they carry this "virus".

Don't speak to the governement, is what my higher ups are saying about this, weird...."}

{"CultureInvariantString":"Look, don't take me for a crazy person but I'm tellin' you, this fucked up scenario is due to these mosquitos the military were testing on.\r\n\r\nLook, I know what you're thinking but its the truth, I don't have much time left as were gonna test some barrels of shit that should fix everything."}

spawner.marker_description: A random event has occured in The Valley. Go and check it out.
